candidates.concept: A rail-yard signal technician pauses beside an open wayside control cabinet at blue hour, logging a diagnostic reading while freight wagons roll slowly in the distance.
candidates.operational_detail: Insulated tools, numbered relays, ballast, warning beacons, and a radio check establish a live maintenance inspection.

candidates.concept: An airport ground-operations coordinator stands under a parked regional jet wing during a turnaround, comparing a loading sheet with the belt loader position.
candidates.operational_detail: Wheel chocks, safety cones, baggage carts, headset cable, ramp markings, and service lights create a credible turnaround scene.

candidates.concept: A hydroelectric turbine-hall operator pauses on a grated inspection platform, reading vibration data from a handheld instrument beside a numbered generator casing.
candidates.operational_detail: Overhead crane rails, pipe runs, oil-stained grating, lockout tags, and indicator lamps ground the portrait in plant operations.

candidates.concept: A container-terminal reefer technician checks a refrigerated container connection between stacked units during a dawn shift.
candidates.operational_detail: Power leads, twist-locks, container codes, gantry structures, wet concrete, and a handheld temperature log make the inspection legible.

candidates.concept: A tram depot maintenance controller observes a pantograph test from a marked safe zone while recording the contact-strip result.
candidates.operational_detail: Overhead catenary, inspection pits, amber beacons, rail grooves, depot bay numbers, and a test console define the event.

candidates.concept: A wind-turbine service planner pauses at the open rear of a field service van, reconciling harness tags with a tower-climb checklist before departure.
candidates.operational_detail: Coiled ropes, labeled cases, torque tools, hard hats, turbine towers, and a gravel access road support the pre-climb narrative.

candidates.concept: A metropolitan bus-depot dispatcher stands beside a charging bay, marking a route-readiness sheet as an electric bus completes its pre-service check.
candidates.operational_detail: Charging coupler, bay numerals, tire-check equipment, route display glow, concrete bollards, and early-shift haze create documentary specificity.

candidates.concept: A night-ferry vehicle-deck loadmaster pauses between numbered lanes during a cargo-securing inspection, marking a checklist as an arriving truck approaches the loading ramp.
candidates.operational_detail: Wet anti-slip steel, reflective vest, chain tensioners, secured cargo, ramp lamps, and distant vehicle lights make the transport operation concrete.

selection_result: A night-ferry vehicle-deck loadmaster pauses between numbered lanes during a cargo-securing inspection, marking a checklist as an arriving truck approaches the loading ramp.
